title: Just Juice Reborn Apple & Pear on Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Reborn Apple & Pear on Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a carefully reformulated version of a classic orchard profile. The inhale provides the crisp, bright taste of fresh Apple combined with the mellow sweetness of juicy Pear. To complete the profile, a brisk layer of Ice is introduced on the exhale, providing a clean, frosty finish that ensures a consistently refreshing and highly authentic fruit vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. Formulated with a specific 40VG/60PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour clarity and a slightly more pronounced throat hit. It is designed to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Just Juice Reborn collection brings back a selection of original e-liquid flavours, refined and updated to deliver a highly concentrated, bar-style experience. Offering exceptional quality and familiarity, this range provides a dependable option for everyday use. Beyond the crisp chill of Apple & Pear on Ice, vapers can explore other revitalised profiles such as the tangy Blue Raspberry or the tropical Mango & Passion Fruit.
